name: run_frame_loop
comment: calls the frame function (main_frame) back to back forever: no VBlank wait; a race frame lasts ~4 video frames

name: install_irq_handlers
comment: copies the VCount handler to IWRAM 0x030001C0; handler table 0x030056D0: mask

name: flip_page
column5: draw into fb +0x10 (or +0xC when fb +8 == 0xF); odd: show page 1

name: read_keys
comment: read_keyinput then the player's control word 0x030057D8 + 2*player = held keys (link play: FUN_0814737c)

name: timer_start
comment: TMxCNT_L = reload; TMxCNT_H = enable | irq << 6 | cascade << 2 | prescaler

name: restart_engine_sound
comment: carbon_play_sound(profile +0x2EF) when the engine loop fell silent

name: camera_dispatch
comment: calls the camera function of view *0x030055F8 from table 0x087F399C (chase view: camera_update)

name: draw_effect_sprites
column6: count) into shadow OAM from the first entry down; clears one-shot objects

name: oam_set_tile
comment: attr2 tile = tile + OBJ tile base *0x030064E0 (10 bits)

name: oam_set_size
comment: size code 0..11 to attr0 shape and attr1 size
